iclr26-C9p44r7o3z — final Overall 3, ICLR rating "4 on {0,2,4,6,8,10} (5 on {1,3,5,6,8,10})" (Borderline Reject).

The literature check did not run. arXiv returned 429/503 and two calls timed out, so I used the no-network fallback and marked every recommended reference `[verify]`.

Main reasons for the Reject-side call (details in `review.md`):
- **Overclaimed headlines:** The abstract's "matches full attention at 64 tokens" fails on Table 6 (LongBench mean 37.37 vs 39.70) and Table 1a (93% vs Quest 99%). On the 100K passkey (Table 1b), Adamas gets 71% at 128 tokens.
- **Thin baselines:** "Prior SOTA" means Quest only, on two Llama-2 models.
- **Untested mechanism:** There is no top-k recall or oracle comparison.
- **Missing Quest latency:** Quest is never timed.
- **Citation error:** The "MOA" bibliography entry is an image-generation paper.

No Devil's Advocate issue was rated CRITICAL, so there was no ceiling. The starting point and the final both came out at 3.
